verdict.rationale: Gladia's pre-recorded quickstart says you can pass a local file, binary data, or a remote URL and the method handles the rest, which covers URL-based ingestion without a manual upload. This rests on a single SDK-level mention, so it is not explicit that the service itself fetches the URL. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that signed or presigned URLs work, API-level documentation of the audio_url parameter and server-side fetch behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
